subject: READ statement
notes: kb/Work PB337, LANDED. The rule has TWO obligations and they are enforced at the two places that can decide them, which is a division by decidability rather than by rule number. (1) The COUNT -- 'there shall be at most one record area subordinate to the FD for file-name-1' -- is CheckIntoReceiver's, via IntoPhraseRules.AdmitsRecordCount over FileModel.Records, diagnostic COBOL1995. (2) The second sentence -- 'shall be a strongly-typed group item of the same type as identifier-1' -- is the same predicate over the same pair that 14.9.25.3 SR2 applies to this phrase's implicit-move SENDER, which IS the record area, and is reported by CheckStrongMove as COBOL1533 naming the phrase (kb/Work PB348). A second copy would be one rule in two places. What the MOVE screen cannot express is the count, because it inspects only FileModel.AreaRecord: a file whose LARGEST record happened to be a strongly-typed group of the right type passed everything, with a second record area no diagnostic could see -- that program is conformance:cases/14.9.30-READ/pb337-read-into-strong-record-areas and it is deliberately distinct from its PB348 sibling, so removing either check fails a test. A strongly-typed identifier-1 draws COBOL1995 alone and not also the SR1 diagnostic, which is derived rather than chosen: 13.18.29.4 GR3 excludes a strongly-typed group from the alphanumeric group items, so SR1 arm b) can never admit one and arm a) is the condition SR2 just tested -- the two rules say the same thing for this receiver. PRE-FIX MEASUREMENT: the note's probe shape is now caught by PB348's COBOL1533 (a different rule), while the count obligation had no check at all; the isolating probe compiled clean. EDITIONS: 2002 and up -- TYPEDEF and the TYPE clause are COBOL-2002 introductions, so the rule is unreachable at 85 by construction (measured: COBOL0900 refuses the declaration there), which is why no edition gate is written for it. The positive golden's case D is the over-reject guard: one record area, itself a strongly-typed group of the same type, is ADMITTED. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/Validation/StatementValidation.cs#CheckStrongMove (kb/Work PB878 deleted StatementValidation.CheckStrongMove; the READ INTO implicit move's same-type check is MoveTable16.StrongGroupRefusal, framed by MoveBinder.MoveCategoryLegality)
